why_this_rate: The rate every part copied here was drawn at on its own type; a chain of parts drawn at one rate has to be drawn at that rate.
what_varies: The flanger's modulator is a raised sine, as the single flanger's leading candidate reads it; the enhancer ahead of it is not drawn.

fixed_rows.40 03 03: Sens: the enhancer path is not drawn. Its single type draws no node for it either, and the one law published for the byte is a band rise measured with the mix at nothing, which says what the path adds at one band and not what the path is.
fixed_rows.40 03 04: Mix: how much of that undrawn path is summed in. At power-on it is 127, so every take here is drawn without a path the unit sounded.
